implementation: Place data-ui-reading-links on an ancestor of a public CenteredShell. Only descendant main-content anchors participate. data-ui-link-style="control" excludes itself and its descendants.
decisions: Attribute recipe rather than a new component or prop: composes the existing shell and preserves the shared prop file already changed on this branch.
Quiet resting underline plus existing ink/focus tokens: readable affordance without new geometry, chrome or motion.
Headings inherit link ink; summary Text keeps its explicit muted role.
Control roles, navigation, header/footer and task-shell subtrees retain their own presentation.
CenteredShell owns the text-layout pruning dependency in the generator as well as generated layers.json, so regeneration and precompiled pruning retain the recipe.
